river:river-t0.title: Before reaching the shore

river:river-t1.summary:
To feel with opened eyes,
to listen with the heart,
to speak with truth.
river:river-t1.title: To feel with opened eyes

river:river-t17.summary:
Awakening mind…
That which is conscious…
For the good of sentience.
river:river-t17.title: Awakening Mind

river:river-t18.summary:
Present, mindful now.
Peaceful heart, a quiet mind.
Harmony’s embrace.
river:river-t18.title: Present, mindful now

river:river-t19.summary:
Being is beyond knowledge,
being is integrity,
being is the totality.
The totality of your experiences,
The sacred energy that unites past and future to the present moment!
river:river-t19.title: Being is beyond knowledge

river:river-t2.summary:
Wind’s Natural Soul…
Leading me to the unknown…
Transcendental Flow.
river:river-t2.title: Wind’s Natural Soul

river:river-t20.summary:
Hands in prayer,
I bow respectfully to each cell in my body,
and to the life in you.
river:river-t20.title: To each cell

river:river-t21.summary:
Heal yourself to heal others,
Heal others to heal yourself.
river:river-t21.title: Heal yourself to heal others

river:river-t23.alt: There is no greater shock in life than birth
river:river-t23.summary:
There is no greater shock in life than birth,
Fighting for survival,
Death is release,
river:river-t23.title: There is no greater shock in life than birth

river:river-t24.summary:
Life itself...
Is death itself...
Full circle,
Balance,
Dance...
Transfer of energy...
Consciousness...
Survival...
river:river-t24.title: Life itself

river:river-t25.summary:
In modern times,
We acquire knowledge,
believing that it is the truth,
only to realize that it is only part of it!
Life itself is knowledge!
Within Life itself resides the knowledge!
The multitude of Life forms that…
river:river-t25.title: In modern times

river:river-t26.summary:
End of Summer Full moon,
Bright in the East…
I could feel the cold wind in the morning rise…
Summer afternoon…
Feeling the Rain coming when you set your light…
It took me half a century to recognize, that both the Sun…
river:river-t26.title: End of Summer Full moon

river:river-t27.summary:
Being One.
Becoming one.
microcosm and Macrocosm.
One
river:river-t27.title: Being One

river:river-t28.alt: With each petal in the wind
river:river-t28.summary:
With each petal in the wind,
I vow to dedicate myself to prosperity and harmony for sentient life.
river:river-t28.title: With each petal in the wind

river:river-t29.alt: Like a petal in the wind
river:river-t29.summary:
Like a petal in the wind,
I surrender to the flow...
river:river-t29.title: Like a petal in the wind

river:river-t3.summary:
Breathe in…
Breathe out…
The energy that connects all forms…
Infinite chains of chemical reactions…
Trillions of cells living within…
What am I?
river:river-t3.title: Breathe in

river:river-t30.summary:
Do not love Love,
Be love,
Love.
river:river-t30.title: Do not love Love

river:river-t31.summary:
The spring awakes,
The Golden Heart is Here!
Pure Counsciousness.
river:river-t31.title: The spring awakes

river:river-t33.summary:
With each blossom,
I vow to dedicate myself to prosperity and harmony for sentient life.
river:river-t33.title: With each blossom

river:river-t38.summary:
Thank you for always being by my side.
With you, my heart flows like a quiet river.
river:river-t38.title: A quiet river

river:river-t4.summary:
Kind loving love,
Kind loving love,
Kind loving love.
river:river-t4.title: Kind loving love

river:river-t5.summary:
Submissiveness,
alien to the shining soul,
breathing union is.
river:river-t5.title: Submissiveness

river:river-t6.summary:
I surrender to the flow…
Reaching the depth of my heart…
Union’s Embrace.
river:river-t6.title: I surrender to the flow

river:river-t7.summary:
Spring Energy,
Blessing our hearts with promising light.
Each blossom, a vow of harmony.
With gratitude, I honour your transience.
river:river-t7.title: Spring Energy
